== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Overlord [[revelation]] is a specific type of spiritual insight achieved during [[advancement]]. Unlike an [[Underlord revelation]], which focuses on the motivations that drive a person to begin their journey, the Overlord [[revelation]] serves as a way for an individual to recognize and refocus their current identity. It does not provide a complete summary of a person's entire being; rather, it offers a new perspective on how they relate to the world around them. While many people fail to reach this stage due to a lack of resources, talent, or foundation, those who successfully discover an [[Underlord revelation]] are often capable of achieving this higher insight. The process can involve [[soulfire]] that refines and strengthens the individual, and it is a necessary component of [[advancement]] toward higher stages like [[Archlord]].}}
